Name: Zalmunna, King of Midian
Summary: Zalmunna, a king of Midian, fled with Zebah from Gideon, was captured at Karkor, and was killed by Gideon.
KeyStory: Zalmunna fled with Zebah beyond Jordan, was taken at Karkor, and taunted Gideon before Gideon rose and slew them both.
RelatedPeople: Gideon; Zebah, King of Midian; Oreb, Prince of Midian; Zeeb, Prince of Midian
LifeLesson: A taunt about manhood was answered by the very man it mocked.
